name: BoolCircuit.CircuitEval.tr
header:
def tr (exact : Bool) : St → Option Bool → (Fin 2 → Option Bool) → Action 2 Bool St
  | .rd1 φ, some b, _ => LA.toAct .pos (.go (.rd2 φ b))
  | .rd1 _, none, _ => LA.toAct 0 .rej
  | .rd2 φ b, some b', w => match pairSym b b' with
    | some s => LA.toAct .pos (lact φ s (w 0) (w 1))
    | none => LA.toAct 0 .rej
  | .rd2 _ _, none, _ => LA.toAct 0 .rej
  | .rewM, _, w =>
    if (w 1).isSome then LA.toAct 0 ⟨none, none, .neg, none, some .rewM⟩
    else LA.toAct 0 ⟨none, none, .pos, none, some .copy⟩
  | .copy, inp, w =>
    if (w 1).isSome then
      match inp with
      | some b => LA.toAct .pos ⟨some (some b), some none, .pos, none, some .copy⟩
      | none => LA.toAct 0 .rej
    else if exact && inp.isSome then LA.toAct 0 .rej
    else LA.toAct 0 ⟨none, none, .neg, none, some (.rewV none)⟩
  | .rewV d, _, w =>
    if (w 0).isSome then LA.toAct 0 ⟨none, none, .neg, none, some (.rewV d)⟩
    else LA.toAct 0 ⟨none, none, .pos, none, some (match d with
      | none => .rewI0
      | some φ => .rd1 φ)⟩
  | .rewI0, _, _ => FinTM.controlAction .neg (some .rewI)
  | .rewI, inp, _ => match inp with
    | some _ => FinTM.controlAction .neg (some .rewI)
    | none => FinTM.controlAction .pos (some (.rd1 .skipN))
  | .app v, _, w =>
    if (w 0).isSome then LA.toAct 0 ⟨none, some none, .pos, none, some (.app v)⟩
    else LA.toAct 0 ⟨some (some v), some none, .neg, none, some (.rewV (some .g))⟩

name: Complexity.enumCont_rewind
header:
private lemma enumCont_rewind {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (start scan : S) (dest : Option S)
    (hstart : ∀ inp work, tm.tr start inp work = controlAction .neg (some scan))
    (hscan : ∀ inp work, tm.tr scan inp work = match inp with
      | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan)
      | none => controlAction .pos dest)
    (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (hs : c.state = some start) :
    ∃ r ≤ c.inputPos.val + 2,
      tm.runFrom c r = {c with state := dest, inputPos := 1}

name: Complexity.enumCont_pad_run
header:
private lemma enumCont_pad_run {k K : ℕ} {S H : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (hk : k ≤ K) (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (host : MultiTapeTM K Bool H)
    (emb : S → H)
    (htr : ∀ q inp work, host.tr (emb q) inp work =
      enumCont_padAction emb (tm.tr q inp
        (fun i => work ⟨i, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt hk⟩)))
    (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (t : ℕ) :
    host.runFrom (enumCont_padCfg emb c) t = enumCont_padCfg emb (tm.runFrom c t)

name: Complexity.enumCont_absorb
header:
private lemma enumCont_absorb {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (qa : S)
    (ha : ∀ inp work, tm.tr qa inp work = controlAction 0 (some qa))
    (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (hc : c.state = some qa) (t : ℕ) : tm.runFrom c t = c

name: Complexity.enumCont_first_anchor
header:
private lemma enumCont_first_anchor {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm stop : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (qa : S)
    (ha : ∀ q, q ≠ qa → ∀ inp work, tm.tr q inp work = stop.tr q inp work)
    (hs : ∀ inp work, stop.tr qa inp work = controlAction 0 (some qa))
    (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (T : ℕ) (hT : (stop.runFrom c T).state = some qa) :
    ∃ t ≤ T, (∀ j < t, (tm.runFrom c j).state ≠ some qa) ∧
      tm.runFrom c t = stop.runFrom c T

name: Complexity.enumCont_halt_transfer
header:
private lemma enumCont_halt_transfer {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm stop : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (qa : S)
    (ha : ∀ q, q ≠ qa → ∀ inp work, tm.tr q inp work = stop.tr q inp work)
    (hs : ∀ inp work, stop.tr qa inp work = controlAction 0 (some qa))
    (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (T : ℕ) (hT : (stop.runFrom c T).state = none) :
    tm.runFrom c T = stop.runFrom c T ∧
      ∀ j ≤ T, (tm.runFrom c j).state ≠ some qa

name: Complexity.enumCont_lift_call
header:
private lemma enumCont_lift_call (M B : FinTM Bool) (hM : 0 < M.k) (hk : M.k ≤ B.k)
    (emb : M.State → B.State)
    (htr : ∀ q inp work, B.tm.tr (emb q) inp work =
      enumCont_padAction emb (M.tm.tr q inp
        (fun i => work ⟨i, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt hk⟩)))
    (q : M.State) (x s y : List Bool) (T : ℕ)
    (hh : (M.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q (stateWord M.k s)) T).state = none)
    (ho : (M.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q (stateWord M.k s)) T).output = y) :
    (B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (emb q) (stateWord B.k s)) T).state = none ∧
      (B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (emb q) (stateWord B.k s)) T).output = y

name: Complexity.enumCont_lift_init
header:
private lemma enumCont_lift_init (M B : FinTM Bool) (hk : M.k ≤ B.k)
    (emb : M.State → B.State)
    (htr : ∀ q inp work, B.tm.tr (emb q) inp work =
      enumCont_padAction emb (M.tm.tr q inp
        (fun i => work ⟨i, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt hk⟩)))

      (B.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (emb M.tm.q₀) (stateWord B.k [])) T).output = y

name: Complexity.cont_write_apply
header:
private lemma cont_write_apply (N : FinNDTM Bool) {y : List Bool}
    (q q' : Fin 6) (x u : List Bool) (p : Fin (y.length + 2))
    (m : SignType) (bx bu : Option Bool) :
    (Action.mk m (choiceTapes (fun _ => (none, 0))
      (bx.map some, if bx.isSome then 1 else 0)
      (bu.map some, if bu.isSome then 1 else 0) (none, 0)) none
      (some (.inl q'))).apply (contLoadCfg (y := y) N q x u p x.length u.length) =
        contLoadCfg (y := y) N q' (x ++ bx.toList) (u ++ bu.toList) (moveInputPos p m)
          (x ++ bx.toList).length (u ++ bu.toList).length

name: Complexity.satEvalAction_apply
header:

    (saved : Cfg M.k Bool M.State w) (u : List Bool) (q q' : SatEvalControl)
    (i i' : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ w.length) (hi' : i' ≤ w.length) (j j' : ℤ)
    (m d : SignType)
    (hm : moveInputPos (⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (w.length + 2)) m = ⟨i' + 1, by omega⟩)

name: Complexity.satRedAction_apply
header:
private lemma satRedAction_apply (x : List Bool) (q q' : Option (Fin 35))
    (i i' : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) (hi' : i' ≤ x.length) (n n' : ℕ)
    (buf buf' : ℤ → Option Bool) (a b a' b' : ℤ) (out out' : List Bool)
    (m : SignType) (w₀ w₁ : Option (Option Bool)) (d₀ d₁ : SignType) (emit : Option Bool)
    (hm : moveInputPos (⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (x.length + 2)) m = ⟨i' + 1, by omega⟩)
    (h₀ : (match w₀ with
      | none => satRedCounter n
      | some c => Function.update (satRedCounter n) a c) = satRedCounter n')
    (h₁ : (match w₁ with | none => buf | some c => Function.update buf b c) = buf')
    (ha : a + d₀.cast = a') (hb : b + d₁.cast = b')
    (ho : out ++ emit.toList = out') :
    (satRedAction m w₀ w₁ d₀ d₁ emit q').apply (satRedCfg x q i hi n buf a b out) =
      satRedCfg x q' i' hi' n' buf' a' b' out'

name: Complexity.satRed_move
header:
private lemma satRed_move (x : List Bool) (q q' : Fin 35)
    (i i' : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) (hi' : i' ≤ x.length) (n : ℕ)
    (buf : ℤ → Option Bool) (a b a' b' : ℤ) (out : List Bool)
    (m d₀ d₁ : SignType)
    (hm : moveInputPos (⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (x.length + 2)) m = ⟨i' + 1, by omega⟩)
    (ha : a + d₀.cast = a') (hb : b + d₁.cast = b')
    (ht : satRedTM.tm.tr q (x[i]?) (fun t : Fin 2 => if t = 0 then satRedCounter n a else buf b) =
      satRedAction m none none d₀ d₁ none (some q')) :
    satRedTM.tm.step (satRedCfg x (some q) i hi n buf a b out) =
      satRedCfg x (some q') i' hi' n buf a' b' out

name: Complexity.satPairAction_apply
header:
private lemma satPairAction_apply (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (saved : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (u : List Bool) (q q' : Option (Fin 8))
    (i i' : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) (hi' : i' ≤ x.length) (j j' : ℤ)
    (m d : SignType) (b : Option Bool) (out : List Bool)
    (hm : moveInputPos (⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (x.length + 2)) m = ⟨i' + 1, by omega⟩)
    (hd : j + d.cast = j') :
    (satPairAction M m d b q').apply (satPairCfg M saved u q i hi j out) =
      satPairCfg M saved u q' i' hi' j' (out ++ b.toList)

name: Complexity.transducerTr
header:
def transducerTr (δ : σ → Bool → σ) (o : σ → Bool → Option Bool) :
    σ → Option Bool → (Fin 0 → Option Bool) → Action 0 Bool σ
  | q, some b, _ => ⟨.pos, fun _ => (none, 0), o q b, some (δ q b)⟩
  | _, none, _ => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, none⟩

name: Complexity.clBank_part
header:

name: Complexity.clCopy_write

    (⟨0, clTwo (none, d) (some (some b), .pos), none, some q'⟩ : Action 2 Bool (Fin 5)).apply
      (clCopyCfg x q p z w record) = clCopyCfg x q' p (z + d) w (record ++ [b])

name: Complexity.clPlacedAction_eq
header:

name: Complexity.LogProg.apply_moves
header:
lemma apply_moves (st : Option (CSt Λ SD m)) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (rt : Fin m → ℤ → Option Bool) (rp : Fin m → ℤ) (dt : Fin kD → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (dp : Fin kD → ℤ) (out : List Bool) (mvI : SignType) (f : Fin m → SignType)
    (st' : CSt Λ SD m) :
    (⟨mvI, Fin.append (fun r => (none, f r)) dIdle, none, some st'⟩ :
        Action (m + kD) Bool (CSt Λ SD m)).apply (mkCfg st ip rt rp dt dp out) =
      mkCfg (some st') (moveInputPos ip mvI) rt (fun r => rp r + f r) dt dp out

name: Complexity.LogProg.apply_regMove
header:
lemma apply_regMove (st : Option (CSt Λ SD m)) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (rt : Fin m → ℤ → Option Bool) (rp : Fin m → ℤ) (dt : Fin kD → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (dp : Fin kD → ℤ) (out : List Bool) (r : Fin m) (mv : SignType) (st' : CSt Λ SD m) :
    (⟨0, Fin.append (regMove r mv) dIdle, none, some st'⟩ :
        Action (m + kD) Bool (CSt Λ SD m)).apply (mkCfg st ip rt rp dt dp out) =
      mkCfg (some st') ip rt (Function.update rp r (rp r + mv)) dt dp out

name: Complexity.LogProg.apply_inputOnly

    (dp : Fin kD → ℤ) (out : List Bool) (mvI : SignType) (st' : CSt Λ SD m) :
    (⟨mvI, fun _ => (none, 0), none, some st'⟩ : Action (m + kD) Bool (CSt Λ SD m)).apply
        (mkCfg st ip rt rp dt dp out) =
      mkCfg (some st') (moveInputPos ip mvI) rt rp dt dp out

name: Turing.FinTM.f2_lenAction_apply

name: Turing.FinTM.f2_catalogRewind
header:
private lemma f2_catalogRewind {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}

name: Turing.FinTM.f2_loop_rewind_bounded
header:

name: Turing.FinTM.rewind_scan_heads
header:
theorem rewind_scan_heads {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (scan : S) (dest : Option S)
    (htr : ∀ inp work, tm.tr scan inp work = match inp with
      | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan)
      | none => controlAction .pos dest) :
    ∀ (j : ℕ) (cfg : Cfg k Bool S x), cfg.state = some scan →
      cfg.inputPos.val = j → j ≤ x.length →
      ∀ u ≤ j + 1, (tm.runFrom cfg u).workTapePos = cfg.workTapePos

name: Turing.FinTM.rewind_heads
header:
theorem rewind_heads {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (start scan : S) (dest : Option S)
    (hstart : ∀ inp work, tm.tr start inp work = controlAction .neg (some scan))
    (hscan : ∀ inp work, tm.tr scan inp work = match inp with
      | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan)
      | none => controlAction .pos dest)
    (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (hs : c.state = some start) :
    ∃ r ≤ c.inputPos.val + 2,
      tm.runFrom c r = {c with state := dest, inputPos := 1} ∧
      ∀ u ≤ r, (tm.runFrom c u).workTapePos = c.workTapePos

private theorem recordStep_native_frame {K : ℕ} {Γ S : Type} {x : List Γ}
    (R : MultiTapeTM K Γ S) (move : S → Option Γ → SignType)
    (next : S → Option Γ → S)

name: Turing.recordStep_tape_run
header:
private theorem recordStep_tape_run {k : ℕ} {Q T S : Type}
    [DecidableEq Q] [DecidableEq T] [DecidableEq S]
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) (upd : T → Option Bool → T)
    (seek : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool S) (start finish : S) {x : List Bool}
    (s : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (hc : c.InWindow s) (data : RecordStepData k Q T) (i : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg 4 (RecSym Q T) (RecordStepControl k Q T S) (x.map (RecSym.digitEmb Q T)))
    (hw : ∀ z : ℤ, -1 ≤ z → z ≤ (2 * s + 1 : ℕ) →
      d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + z) = FinTM.bufferTape
        ((List.range (2 * s + 1)).map fun (r : ℕ) =>
          RecSym.cell (c.workTapes i ((r : ℤ) - s)) (decide (c.workTapePos i = (r : ℤ) - s))) z) :
    RecordRun (recordStepMachine M upd seek start finish)
      (recordStepVerdict true) (recordStepVerdict false) d.workTapePos (2 * s + 2)
      {d with state := some ⟨⟨.writeTape i, data⟩, .fwd ()⟩}
      {d with
        state := some ⟨⟨.skipNewTape i, data⟩, .run⟩
        workTapes := fun j z =>
          if j = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ z ∧ z < d.workTapePos j + (2 * s + 1 : ℕ) then
            FinTM.bufferTape ((List.range (2 * s + 1)).map fun (r : ℕ) =>
              RecSym.cell (((recordStepAction M data).apply c).workTapes i ((r : ℤ) - s))
                (decide (((recordStepAction M data).apply c).workTapePos i = (r : ℤ) - s)))
              (z - d.workTapePos j)
          else d.workTapes j z} (4 * (2 * s + 1) + 6)

name: Turing.recordStep_apply_run
header:
private theorem recordStep_apply_run {k : ℕ} {Q T S : Type}
    [DecidableEq Q] [DecidableEq T] [DecidableEq S]
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) (upd : T → Option Bool → T)
    (seek : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool S) (start finish : S) {x : List Bool}
    (s : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (τ : T) (hc : c.InWindow s)
    (data : RecordStepData k Q T) (hinput : data.input = c.inputSymbol)
    (hzero : data.posZero = decide (c.inputPos.val = 0)) (htag : data.tag = some τ)
    (d : Cfg 4 (RecSym Q T) (RecordStepControl k Q T S) (x.map (RecSym.digitEmb Q T)))
    (hrec : RecordAt d 0 (cfgRecord s c τ))
    (blank : ∀ j : Fin 4, j ≠ 0 → ∀ z, d.workTapes j z = none) :
    ∃ t ≤ 40 * (k + 3) * ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length + 1),
      RecordRun (recordStepMachine M upd seek start finish)
        (recordStepVerdict true) (recordStepVerdict false) d.workTapePos
        ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length + 1)
        (recordStepSnapshot d (⟨⟨.writeState, data⟩, .fwd ()⟩ : RecordStepControl k Q T S) 0
          ((binDigits (posWidth x.length) c.inputPos.val).map (RecSym.digitEmb Q T)) [])
        {d with
          state := some (recordStepVerdict true)
          workTapes := fun j z =>
            if j = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ z ∧ z < d.workTapePos j + ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length : ℤ)
              then fieldsTape (cfgRecord s ((recordStepAction M data).apply c)
                (upd τ (recordStepAction M data).output)) (z - d.workTapePos j)
              else d.workTapes j z} t

    (seek : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool S) (start finish : S) {x : List Bool}
    (s : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (hc : c.InWindow s) (data : RecordStepData k Q T) (i : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg 4 (RecSym Q T) (RecordStepControl k Q T S) (x.map (RecSym.digitEmb Q T)))
    (hw : ∀ z : ℤ, -1 ≤ z → z ≤ (2 * s + 1 : ℕ) →
      d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + z) = FinTM.bufferTape
        ((List.range (2 * s + 1)).map fun (r : ℕ) =>
          RecSym.cell (c.workTapes i ((r : ℤ) - s)) (decide (c.workTapePos i = (r : ℤ) - s))) z) :
    RecordSeg (recordStepMachine M upd seek start finish)
      (recordStepVerdict true) (recordStepVerdict false) d.workTapePos (2 * s + 2)
      {d with state := some ⟨⟨.writeTape i, data⟩, .fwd ()⟩}
      {d with
        state := some ⟨⟨.skipNewTape i, data⟩, .run⟩
        workTapes := fun j z =>
          if j = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ z ∧ z < d.workTapePos j + (2 * s + 1 : ℕ) then
            FinTM.bufferTape ((List.range (2 * s + 1)).map fun (r : ℕ) =>
              RecSym.cell (((recordStepAction M data).apply c).workTapes i ((r : ℤ) - s))
                (decide (((recordStepAction M data).apply c).workTapePos i = (r : ℤ) - s)))
              (z - d.workTapePos j)
          else d.workTapes j z} (4 * (2 * s + 1) + 6)

name: Turing.recordStep_apply_run
header:
private theorem recordStep_apply_run {k : ℕ} {Q T S : Type}
    [DecidableEq Q] [DecidableEq T] [DecidableEq S]
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) (upd : T → Option Bool → T)
    (seek : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool S) (start finish : S) {x : List Bool}
    (s : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (τ : T) (hc : c.InWindow s)
    (data : RecordStepData k Q T) (hinput : data.input = c.inputSymbol)
    (hzero : data.posZero = decide (c.inputPos.val = 0)) (htag : data.tag = some τ)
    (d : Cfg 4 (RecSym Q T) (RecordStepControl k Q T S) (x.map (RecSym.digitEmb Q T)))
    (hrec : RecordAt d 0 (cfgRecord s c τ))
    (blank : ∀ j : Fin 4, j ≠ 0 → ∀ z, d.workTapes j z = none) :
    ∃ t ≤ 40 * (k + 3) * ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length + 1),
      RecordSeg (recordStepMachine M upd seek start finish)
        (recordStepVerdict true) (recordStepVerdict false) d.workTapePos
        ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length + 1)
        (recordStepSnapshot d (⟨⟨.writeState, data⟩, .fwd ()⟩ : RecordStepControl k Q T S) 0
          ((binDigits (posWidth x.length) c.inputPos.val).map (RecSym.digitEmb Q T)) [])
        {d with
          state := some (recordStepVerdict true)
          workTapes := fun j z =>
            if j = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ z ∧ z < d.workTapePos j + ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length : ℤ)
              then fieldsTape (cfgRecord s ((recordStepAction M data).apply c)
                (upd τ (recordStepAction M data).output)) (z - d.workTapePos j)
              else d.workTapes j z} t

name: Turing.ClockHost.apply_hostCfg
header:
theorem apply_hostCfg {SS AS : Type} {s a : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (im : SignType)
    (sa : Fin s → Option (Option Bool) × SignType) (aa : Fin a → Option (Option Bool) × SignType)
    (ya : Option (Option Bool) × SignType) (o : Option Bool) (q' q : Option (ClockPhase SS AS))
    (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (sT : Fin s → ℤ → Option Bool) (sP : Fin s → ℤ)
    (aT : Fin a → ℤ → Option Bool) (aP : Fin a → ℤ) (yT : ℤ → Option Bool) (yP : ℤ)
    (out : List Bool) :
    (⟨im, slots sa aa ya, o, q'⟩ : Action (s + a + 1) Bool (ClockPhase SS AS)).apply
        (hostCfg q ip sT sP aT aP yT yP out) =
      hostCfg q' (moveInputPos ip im) (fun i => tapeAfter (sa i) (sT i) (sP i))
        (fun i => sP i + (sa i).2) (fun i => tapeAfter (aa i) (aT i) (aP i))
        (fun i => aP i + (aa i).2) (tapeAfter ya yT yP) (yP + ya.2) (out ++ o.toList)

name: Turing.StepBlock.recordSkipTM_run
header:
lemma recordSkipTM_run {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x)
    (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (actionBitsK a).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((actionBitsK a)[r]'hr)) :
    (recordSkipTM k).runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk false)) ((actionBitsK a).length + 1) =
      { d.mapState (fun _ => (⟨true, SuccPhase.done a.state.isSome⟩ : Σ b, SkipPh k b)) with
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (tableTape k)
          (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + (actionBitsK a).length) }

name: Turing.StepBlock.recordSkipTM_spec
header:
lemma recordSkipTM_spec {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x)
    (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (actionBitsK a).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((actionBitsK a)[r]'hr)) :
    (∀ u < (actionBitsK a).length + 1, ∀ b,
      ((recordSkipTM k).runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk false)) u).state ≠ some ⟨true, .done b⟩) ∧
    (∀ u ≤ (actionBitsK a).length + 1,
      let f := (recordSkipTM k).runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk false)) u
      f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.output = d.output ∧
      (∀ j, f.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j +
        if j = tableTape k then ((min u (recordWidth k) + (u - (recordWidth k + 1)) : ℕ) : ℤ)
        else 0))

name: Turing.StepBlock.seekTM_request
header:
private lemma seekTM_request {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x)
    (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (rank rest : Fin (3 ^ (k + 1))) (last : Bool)
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (actionBitsK a).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((actionBitsK a)[r]'hr)) :
    (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.request rank rest last)) ((actionBitsK a).length + 3) =
      seekCfg ({ d with
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (tableTape k)
            (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + (actionBitsK a).length) }) (seekNext rank rest last) ∧
    (∀ u < (actionBitsK a).length + 3,
      ((seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.request rank rest last)) u).state ≠ some ⟨none, .done⟩) ∧
    (∀ u ≤ (actionBitsK a).length + 3,
      let f := (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.request rank rest last)) u
      f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.output = d.output ∧
      ∀ j, j ≠ tableTape k → f.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

name: Turing.StepBlock.seekTM_rank
header:
private lemma seekTM_rank {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (records : List (Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))))
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x) (rank : Fin (3 ^ (k + 1)))
    (hlen : records.length = rank.val)
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hs : d.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k) = some false)
    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (records.flatMap actionBitsK).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((records.flatMap actionBitsK)[r]'hr)) :
    (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.state rank)) (1 + seekCost records) =
      seekCfg ({d with
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (tableTape k)
          (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + (records.flatMap actionBitsK).length)}) .done ∧
    (∀ u < 1 + seekCost records,
      ((seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.state rank)) u).state ≠ some ⟨none, .done⟩) ∧
    (∀ u ≤ 1 + seekCost records,
      let f := (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.state rank)) u
      f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.output = d.output ∧
      ∀ j, j ≠ tableTape k → f.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

name: Turing.StepBlock.part
header:
private def part (k : ℕ) : (key : Key) → MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool (Ph k key)
  | .entry | .halt => ⟨(), fun _ _ _ => inputMoveAction 0 ()⟩
  | .lookup => seekTM k
  | .stateTail | .stateGap _ => skipTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k)
  | .stateHome | .stateRestore _ => skipBackTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k)
  | .clearState => clearTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k)
  | .toSummary | .finish _ => twoMoveTM (summaryTape k) .neg
  | .toState => twoMoveTM (summaryTape k) .pos
  | .record => recordTM k
  | .successor => succFieldTM (tableTape k) (summaryTape k) true
  | .tableTail _ => skipTM (k + 2) (tableTape k)
  | .tableHome _ => skipBackTM (k + 2) (tableTape k)

name: Turing.StepBlock.roundTM_firstExit_unique
header:
theorem roundTM_firstExit_unique {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin k → Option Bool) → Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (q : Fin (n + 1)) (hq : c.state = some q)
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x)
    (entry : d.state = some ⟨.entry, ()⟩) (rel : Rep tr c d) :

        ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).state = some ⟨.halt, ()⟩) ∧
      ∀ u, 0 < u → u < T →
        ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state ≠ some ⟨.entry, ()⟩ ∧
          ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state ≠ some ⟨.halt, ()⟩

lemma rewind_scan {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (scan : S) (dest : Option S)
    (htr : ∀ inp work, tm.tr scan inp work =
      match inp with
      | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan)
      | none => controlAction .pos dest) :
    ∀ (cfg : Cfg k Bool S x), cfg.state = some scan → cfg.inputPos.val ≤ x.length →
      tm.runFrom cfg (cfg.inputPos.val + 1) = {cfg with state := dest, inputPos := 1}

private lemma cont_write_apply (N : FinNDTM Bool) {y : List Bool}
    (q q' : Fin 6) (x u : List Bool) (p : Fin (y.length + 2))
    (m : SignType) (bx bu : Option Bool) :
    (Action.mk m (choiceTapes (fun _ => (none, 0))
      (bx.map some, if bx.isSome then 1 else 0)
      (bu.map some, if bu.isSome then 1 else 0) (none, 0)) none

name: Complexity.satRedAction_apply
header:
private lemma satRedAction_apply (x : List Bool) (q q' : Option (Fin 35))
    (i i' : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) (hi' : i' ≤ x.length) (n n' : ℕ)
    (buf buf' : ℤ → Option Bool) (a b a' b' : ℤ) (out out' : List Bool)
    (m : SignType) (w₀ w₁ : Option (Option Bool)) (d₀ d₁ : SignType) (emit : Option Bool)
    (hm : moveInputPos (⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (x.length + 2)) m = ⟨i' + 1, by omega⟩)
    (h₀ : (match w₀ with
      | none => satRedCounter n
      | some c => Function.update (satRedCounter n) a c) = satRedCounter n')
    (h₁ : (match w₁ with | none => buf | some c => Function.update buf b c) = buf')
    (ha : a + d₀.cast = a') (hb : b + d₁.cast = b')
    (ho : out ++ emit.toList = out') :
    (satRedAction m w₀ w₁ d₀ d₁ emit q').apply (satRedCfg x q i hi n buf a b out) =
      satRedCfg x q' i' hi' n' buf' a' b' out'

    (ht : satRedTM.tm.tr q (x[i]?) (fun t : Fin 2 => if t = 0 then satRedCounter n a else buf b) =
      satRedAction m none none d₀ d₁ none (some q')) :

name: Turing.timedCut_skip_record
header:
private lemma timedCut_skip_record {x : List Bool} {n : ℕ}
    (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (dest : Option (Fin 9)) (rem : Fin 9)
    (table : List Bool) (state : ℤ → Option Bool) (sp : ℤ)
    (a : Action 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (l r : List Bool)
    (ht : table = l ++ universalRecordBits a ++ r) :
    timedCutInterpreter.runFrom
      (universalEvalCfg base (.skipFixed dest rem 0) table l.length state sp)
      (universalRecordBits a).length =
    universalEvalCfg base
      (if h : rem.val = 0 then universalSkipDone dest
        else .skipFixed dest ⟨rem.val - 1, by omega⟩ 0)
      table (l.length + (universalRecordBits a).length) state sp

    (hstate : d.state = some (.fwd a₀)) (hin : d.inputPos = 1) (t : ℕ) :
    (inputFoldTM k δ a₀).runFrom d t =
      catalogTrace (scanFoldF δ a₀ d) (scanFoldR δ a₀ d)
        { d with state := some (.done (x.foldl δ a₀)) } x.length t

    (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x)
    (hstate : d.state = some (.fwd a₀)) (hin : d.inputPos = 1) :
    (inputFoldTM k δ a₀).runFrom d (2 * x.length + 2) =
        { d with state := some (.done (x.foldl δ a₀)) } ∧
      (∀ t < 2 * x.length + 2, ∀ a,
        ((inputFoldTM k δ a₀).runFrom d t).state ≠ some (.done a)) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ 2 * x.length + 2 →
        ((inputFoldTM k δ a₀).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

    (table : List Bool) (state : ℤ → Option Bool) (sp : ℤ)
    (a : Action 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (l r : List Bool)
    (ht : table = l ++ universalRecordBits a ++ r) :

header:
private theorem recordStep_tape_run {k : ℕ} {Q T S : Type}
    [DecidableEq Q] [DecidableEq T] [DecidableEq S]
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) (upd : T → Option Bool → T)
    (seek : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool S) (start finish : S) {x : List Bool}
    (s : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (hc : c.InWindow s) (data : RecordStepData k Q T) (i : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg 4 (RecSym Q T) (RecordStepControl k Q T S) (x.map (RecSym.digitEmb Q T)))
    (hw : ∀ z : ℤ, -1 ≤ z → z ≤ (2 * s + 1 : ℕ) →
      d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + z) = FinTM.bufferTape
        ((List.range (2 * s + 1)).map fun (r : ℕ) =>
          RecSym.cell (c.workTapes i ((r : ℤ) - s)) (decide (c.workTapePos i = (r : ℤ) - s))) z) :
    RecordSeg (recordStepMachine M upd seek start finish)
      (recordStepVerdict true) (recordStepVerdict false) d.workTapePos (2 * s + 2)
      {d with state := some ⟨⟨.writeTape i, data⟩, .fwd ()⟩}
      {d with
        state := some ⟨⟨.skipNewTape i, data⟩, .run⟩
        workTapes := fun j z =>
          if j = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ z ∧ z < d.workTapePos j + (2 * s + 1 : ℕ) then
            FinTM.bufferTape ((List.range (2 * s + 1)).map fun (r : ℕ) =>
              RecSym.cell (((recordStepAction M data).apply c).workTapes i ((r : ℤ) - s))
                (decide (((recordStepAction M data).apply c).workTapePos i = (r : ℤ) - s)))
              (z - d.workTapePos j)
          else d.workTapes j z} (4 * (2 * s + 1) + 6)

name: Turing.recordStep_apply_run
header:
private theorem recordStep_apply_run {k : ℕ} {Q T S : Type}
    [DecidableEq Q] [DecidableEq T] [DecidableEq S]
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) (upd : T → Option Bool → T)
    (seek : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool S) (start finish : S) {x : List Bool}
    (s : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (τ : T) (hc : c.InWindow s)
    (data : RecordStepData k Q T) (hinput : data.input = c.inputSymbol)
    (hzero : data.posZero = decide (c.inputPos.val = 0)) (htag : data.tag = some τ)
    (d : Cfg 4 (RecSym Q T) (RecordStepControl k Q T S) (x.map (RecSym.digitEmb Q T)))
    (hrec : RecordAt d 0 (cfgRecord s c τ))
    (blank : ∀ j : Fin 4, j ≠ 0 → ∀ z, d.workTapes j z = none) :
    ∃ t ≤ 40 * (k + 3) * ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length + 1),
      RecordSeg (recordStepMachine M upd seek start finish)
        (recordStepVerdict true) (recordStepVerdict false) d.workTapePos
        ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length + 1)
        (recordStepSnapshot d (⟨⟨.writeState, data⟩, .fwd ()⟩ : RecordStepControl k Q T S) 0
          ((binDigits (posWidth x.length) c.inputPos.val).map (RecSym.digitEmb Q T)) [])
        {d with
          state := some (recordStepVerdict true)
          workTapes := fun j z =>
            if j = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ z ∧ z < d.workTapePos j + ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length : ℤ)
              then fieldsTape (cfgRecord s ((recordStepAction M data).apply c)
                (upd τ (recordStepAction M data).output)) (z - d.workTapePos j)
              else d.workTapes j z} t

      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((actionBitsK a)[r]'hr)) :
    (∀ u < (actionBitsK a).length + 1, ∀ b,
      ((recordSkipTM k).runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk false)) u).state ≠ some ⟨true, .done b⟩) ∧
    (∀ u ≤ (actionBitsK a).length + 1,
      let f := (recordSkipTM k).runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk false)) u
      f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.output = d.output ∧
      (∀ j, f.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j +
        if j = tableTape k then ((min u (recordWidth k) + (u - (recordWidth k + 1)) : ℕ) : ℤ)

    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (actionBitsK a).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((actionBitsK a)[r]'hr)) :
    (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.request rank rest last)) ((actionBitsK a).length + 3) =
      seekCfg ({ d with
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (tableTape k)
            (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + (actionBitsK a).length) }) (seekNext rank rest last) ∧
    (∀ u < (actionBitsK a).length + 3,
      ((seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.request rank rest last)) u).state ≠ some ⟨none, .done⟩) ∧
    (∀ u ≤ (actionBitsK a).length + 3,
      let f := (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.request rank rest last)) u
      f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.output = d.output ∧
      ∀ j, j ≠ tableTape k → f.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

name: Turing.StepBlock.seekTM_rank
header:
private lemma seekTM_rank {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (records : List (Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))))
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x) (rank : Fin (3 ^ (k + 1)))
    (hlen : records.length = rank.val)
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hs : d.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k) = some false)
    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (records.flatMap actionBitsK).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((records.flatMap actionBitsK)[r]'hr)) :
    (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.state rank)) (1 + seekCost records) =
      seekCfg ({d with
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (tableTape k)
          (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + (records.flatMap actionBitsK).length)}) .done ∧
    (∀ u < 1 + seekCost records,
      ((seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.state rank)) u).state ≠ some ⟨none, .done⟩) ∧
    (∀ u ≤ 1 + seekCost records,
      let f := (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.state rank)) u
      f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.output = d.output ∧
      ∀ j, j ≠ tableTape k → f.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

name: Turing.StepBlock.part
header:
private def part (k : ℕ) : (key : Key) → MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool (Ph k key)
  | .entry | .halt => ⟨(), fun _ _ _ => inputMoveAction 0 ()⟩
  | .lookup => seekTM k
  | .stateTail | .stateGap _ => skipTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k)
  | .stateHome | .stateRestore _ => skipBackTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k)
  | .clearState => clearTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k)
  | .toSummary | .finish _ => twoMoveTM (summaryTape k) .neg
  | .toState => twoMoveTM (summaryTape k) .pos
  | .record => recordTM k
  | .successor => succFieldTM (tableTape k) (summaryTape k) true
  | .tableTail _ => skipTM (k + 2) (tableTape k)
  | .tableHome _ => skipBackTM (k + 2) (tableTape k)

name: Turing.recordStep_tape_run
header:
private theorem recordStep_tape_run {k : ℕ} {Q T S : Type}
    [DecidableEq Q] [DecidableEq T] [DecidableEq S]
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) (upd : T → Option Bool → T)
    (seek : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool S) (start finish : S) {x : List Bool}
    (s : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (hc : c.InWindow s) (data : RecordStepData k Q T) (i : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg 4 (RecSym Q T) (RecordStepControl k Q T S) (x.map (RecSym.digitEmb Q T)))
    (hw : ∀ z : ℤ, -1 ≤ z → z ≤ (2 * s + 1 : ℕ) →
      d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + z) = FinTM.bufferTape
        ((List.range (2 * s + 1)).map fun (r : ℕ) =>
          RecSym.cell (c.workTapes i ((r : ℤ) - s)) (decide (c.workTapePos i = (r : ℤ) - s))) z) :
    RecordSeg (recordStepMachine M upd seek start finish)
      (recordStepVerdict true) (recordStepVerdict false) d.workTapePos (2 * s + 2)
      {d with state := some ⟨⟨.writeTape i, data⟩, .fwd ()⟩}
      {d with
        state := some ⟨⟨.skipNewTape i, data⟩, .run⟩
        workTapes := fun j z =>
          if j = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ z ∧ z < d.workTapePos j + (2 * s + 1 : ℕ) then
            FinTM.bufferTape ((List.range (2 * s + 1)).map fun (r : ℕ) =>
              RecSym.cell (((recordStepAction M data).apply c).workTapes i ((r : ℤ) - s))
                (decide (((recordStepAction M data).apply c).workTapePos i = (r : ℤ) - s)))
              (z - d.workTapePos j)
          else d.workTapes j z} (4 * (2 * s + 1) + 6)

name: Turing.recordStep_apply_run

    (s : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (τ : T) (hc : c.InWindow s)
    (data : RecordStepData k Q T) (hinput : data.input = c.inputSymbol)
    (hzero : data.posZero = decide (c.inputPos.val = 0)) (htag : data.tag = some τ)
    (d : Cfg 4 (RecSym Q T) (RecordStepControl k Q T S) (x.map (RecSym.digitEmb Q T)))
    (hrec : RecordAt d 0 (cfgRecord s c τ))
    (blank : ∀ j : Fin 4, j ≠ 0 → ∀ z, d.workTapes j z = none) :
    ∃ t ≤ 40 * (k + 3) * ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length + 1),
      RecordSeg (recordStepMachine M upd seek start finish)
        (recordStepVerdict true) (recordStepVerdict false) d.workTapePos
        ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length + 1)
        (recordStepSnapshot d (⟨⟨.writeState, data⟩, .fwd ()⟩ : RecordStepControl k Q T S) 0
          ((binDigits (posWidth x.length) c.inputPos.val).map (RecSym.digitEmb Q T)) [])
        {d with
          state := some (recordStepVerdict true)
          workTapes := fun j z =>
            if j = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ z ∧ z < d.workTapePos j + ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length : ℤ)
              then fieldsTape (cfgRecord s ((recordStepAction M data).apply c)

              else d.workTapes j z} t

        ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length + 1)
        (recordStepSnapshot d (⟨⟨.writeState, data⟩, .fwd ()⟩ : RecordStepControl k Q T S) 0
          ((binDigits (posWidth x.length) c.inputPos.val).map (RecSym.digitEmb Q T)) [])
        {d with
          state := some (recordStepVerdict true)
          workTapes := fun j z =>
            if j = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ z ∧ z < d.workTapePos j + ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length : ℤ)
              then fieldsTape (cfgRecord s ((recordStepAction M data).apply c)
                (upd τ (recordStepAction M data).output)) (z - d.workTapePos j)
              else d.workTapes j z} t

name: Turing.StepBlock.recordSkipTM_spec
header:
lemma recordSkipTM_spec {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x)

    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (actionBitsK a).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((actionBitsK a)[r]'hr)) :
    (∀ u < (actionBitsK a).length + 1, ∀ b,
      ((recordSkipTM k).runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk false)) u).state ≠ some ⟨true, .done b⟩) ∧
    (∀ u ≤ (actionBitsK a).length + 1,
      let f := (recordSkipTM k).runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk false)) u
      f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.output = d.output ∧
      (∀ j, f.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j +
        if j = tableTape k then ((min u (recordWidth k) + (u - (recordWidth k + 1)) : ℕ) : ℤ)
        else 0))

header:
private lemma seekTM_request {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x)
    (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (rank rest : Fin (3 ^ (k + 1))) (last : Bool)
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (actionBitsK a).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((actionBitsK a)[r]'hr)) :
    (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.request rank rest last)) ((actionBitsK a).length + 3) =
      seekCfg ({ d with
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (tableTape k)
            (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + (actionBitsK a).length) }) (seekNext rank rest last) ∧
    (∀ u < (actionBitsK a).length + 3,
      ((seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.request rank rest last)) u).state ≠ some ⟨none, .done⟩) ∧
    (∀ u ≤ (actionBitsK a).length + 3,
      let f := (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.request rank rest last)) u
      f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.output = d.output ∧
      ∀ j, j ≠ tableTape k → f.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

name: Turing.StepBlock.seekTM_rank
header:
private lemma seekTM_rank {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (records : List (Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))))
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x) (rank : Fin (3 ^ (k + 1)))
    (hlen : records.length = rank.val)
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hs : d.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k) = some false)
    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (records.flatMap actionBitsK).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((records.flatMap actionBitsK)[r]'hr)) :
    (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.state rank)) (1 + seekCost records) =
      seekCfg ({d with
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (tableTape k)
          (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + (records.flatMap actionBitsK).length)}) .done ∧
    (∀ u < 1 + seekCost records,
      ((seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.state rank)) u).state ≠ some ⟨none, .done⟩) ∧
    (∀ u ≤ 1 + seekCost records,
      let f := (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.state rank)) u
      f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.output = d.output ∧
      ∀ j, j ≠ tableTape k → f.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

name: Turing.StepBlock.part
header:
private def part (k : ℕ) : (key : Key) → MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool (Ph k key)
  | .entry | .halt => ⟨(), fun _ _ _ => inputMoveAction 0 ()⟩
  | .lookup => seekTM k
  | .stateTail | .stateGap _ => skipTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k)
  | .stateHome | .stateRestore _ => skipBackTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k)
  | .clearState => clearTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k)
  | .toSummary | .finish _ => twoMoveTM (summaryTape k) .neg
  | .toState => twoMoveTM (summaryTape k) .pos
  | .record => recordTM k
  | .successor => succFieldTM (tableTape k) (summaryTape k) true
  | .tableTail _ => skipTM (k + 2) (tableTape k)
  | .tableHome _ => skipBackTM (k + 2) (tableTape k)

name: Turing.recordStep_tape_run
header:
private theorem recordStep_tape_run {k : ℕ} {Q T S : Type}
    [DecidableEq Q] [DecidableEq T] [DecidableEq S]
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) (upd : T → Option Bool → T)
    (seek : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool S) (start finish : S) {x : List Bool}
    (s : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (hc : c.InWindow s) (data : RecordStepData k Q T) (i : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg 4 (RecSym Q T) (RecordStepControl k Q T S) (x.map (RecSym.digitEmb Q T)))
    (hw : ∀ z : ℤ, -1 ≤ z → z ≤ (2 * s + 1 : ℕ) →
      d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + z) = FinTM.bufferTape
        ((List.range (2 * s + 1)).map fun (r : ℕ) =>
          RecSym.cell (c.workTapes i ((r : ℤ) - s)) (decide (c.workTapePos i = (r : ℤ) - s))) z) :
    RecordRun (recordStepMachine M upd seek start finish)
      (recordStepVerdict true) (recordStepVerdict false) d.workTapePos (2 * s + 2)
      {d with state := some ⟨⟨.writeTape i, data⟩, .fwd ()⟩}
      {d with
        state := some ⟨⟨.skipNewTape i, data⟩, .run⟩
        workTapes := fun j z =>
          if j = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ z ∧ z < d.workTapePos j + (2 * s + 1 : ℕ) then
            FinTM.bufferTape ((List.range (2 * s + 1)).map fun (r : ℕ) =>
              RecSym.cell (((recordStepAction M data).apply c).workTapes i ((r : ℤ) - s))
                (decide (((recordStepAction M data).apply c).workTapePos i = (r : ℤ) - s)))
              (z - d.workTapePos j)
          else d.workTapes j z} (4 * (2 * s + 1) + 6)

name: Turing.recordStep_apply_run
header:
private theorem recordStep_apply_run {k : ℕ} {Q T S : Type}
    [DecidableEq Q] [DecidableEq T] [DecidableEq S]
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) (upd : T → Option Bool → T)
    (seek : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool S) (start finish : S) {x : List Bool}
    (s : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (τ : T) (hc : c.InWindow s)
    (data : RecordStepData k Q T) (hinput : data.input = c.inputSymbol)
    (hzero : data.posZero = decide (c.inputPos.val = 0)) (htag : data.tag = some τ)
    (d : Cfg 4 (RecSym Q T) (RecordStepControl k Q T S) (x.map (RecSym.digitEmb Q T)))
    (hrec : RecordAt d 0 (cfgRecord s c τ))
    (blank : ∀ j : Fin 4, j ≠ 0 → ∀ z, d.workTapes j z = none) :
    ∃ t ≤ 40 * (k + 3) * ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length + 1),
      RecordRun (recordStepMachine M upd seek start finish)
        (recordStepVerdict true) (recordStepVerdict false) d.workTapePos
        ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length + 1)
        (recordStepSnapshot d (⟨⟨.writeState, data⟩, .fwd ()⟩ : RecordStepControl k Q T S) 0
          ((binDigits (posWidth x.length) c.inputPos.val).map (RecSym.digitEmb Q T)) [])
        {d with
          state := some (recordStepVerdict true)
          workTapes := fun j z =>
            if j = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ z ∧ z < d.workTapePos j + ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length : ℤ)
              then fieldsTape (cfgRecord s ((recordStepAction M data).apply c)
                (upd τ (recordStepAction M data).output)) (z - d.workTapePos j)
              else d.workTapes j z} t

    (R : MultiTapeTM k Symbol (S ⊕ Unit))

lemma recordSkipTM_run {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x)
    (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (actionBitsK a).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((actionBitsK a)[r]'hr)) :
    (recordSkipTM k).runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk false)) ((actionBitsK a).length + 1) =
      { d.mapState (fun _ => (⟨true, SuccPhase.done a.state.isSome⟩ : Σ b, SkipPh k b)) with
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (tableTape k)
          (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + (actionBitsK a).length) }

name: Turing.StepBlock.recordSkipTM_spec
header:
lemma recordSkipTM_spec {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x)
    (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (actionBitsK a).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((actionBitsK a)[r]'hr)) :
    (∀ u < (actionBitsK a).length + 1, ∀ b,
      ((recordSkipTM k).runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk false)) u).state ≠ some ⟨true, .done b⟩) ∧
    (∀ u ≤ (actionBitsK a).length + 1,
      let f := (recordSkipTM k).runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk false)) u
      f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.output = d.output ∧
      (∀ j, f.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j +
        if j = tableTape k then ((min u (recordWidth k) + (u - (recordWidth k + 1)) : ℕ) : ℤ)
        else 0))

name: Turing.StepBlock.seekTM_request
header:
private lemma seekTM_request {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x)
    (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (rank rest : Fin (3 ^ (k + 1))) (last : Bool)
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (actionBitsK a).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((actionBitsK a)[r]'hr)) :
    (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.request rank rest last)) ((actionBitsK a).length + 3) =
      seekCfg ({ d with
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (tableTape k)
            (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + (actionBitsK a).length) }) (seekNext rank rest last) ∧
    (∀ u < (actionBitsK a).length + 3,
      ((seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.request rank rest last)) u).state ≠ some ⟨none, .done⟩) ∧
    (∀ u ≤ (actionBitsK a).length + 3,
      let f := (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.request rank rest last)) u
      f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.output = d.output ∧
      ∀ j, j ≠ tableTape k → f.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

name: Turing.StepBlock.seekTM_rank
header:
private lemma seekTM_rank {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (records : List (Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))))
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x) (rank : Fin (3 ^ (k + 1)))
    (hlen : records.length = rank.val)
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hs : d.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k) = some false)
    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (records.flatMap actionBitsK).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((records.flatMap actionBitsK)[r]'hr)) :
    (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.state rank)) (1 + seekCost records) =
      seekCfg ({d with
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (tableTape k)
          (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + (records.flatMap actionBitsK).length)}) .done ∧
    (∀ u < 1 + seekCost records,
      ((seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.state rank)) u).state ≠ some ⟨none, .done⟩) ∧
    (∀ u ≤ 1 + seekCost records,
      let f := (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.state rank)) u
      f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.output = d.output ∧
      ∀ j, j ≠ tableTape k → f.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

name: Turing.StepBlock.part
header:
private def part (k : ℕ) : (key : Key) → MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool (Ph k key)
  | .entry | .halt => ⟨(), fun _ _ _ => inputMoveAction 0 ()⟩
  | .lookup => seekTM k
  | .stateTail | .stateGap _ => skipTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k)
  | .stateHome | .stateRestore _ => skipBackTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k)
  | .clearState => clearTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k)
  | .toSummary | .finish _ => twoMoveTM (summaryTape k) .neg
  | .toState => twoMoveTM (summaryTape k) .pos
  | .record => recordTM k
  | .successor => succFieldTM (tableTape k) (summaryTape k) true
  | .tableTail _ => skipTM (k + 2) (tableTape k)
  | .tableHome _ => skipBackTM (k + 2) (tableTape k)

    (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (q : Fin (n + 1)) (hq : c.state = some q)

name: Complexity.satRedAction_apply
header:
private lemma satRedAction_apply (x : List Bool) (q q' : Option (Fin 35))
    (i i' : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ x.length) (hi' : i' ≤ x.length) (n n' : ℕ)
    (buf buf' : ℤ → Option Bool) (a b a' b' : ℤ) (out out' : List Bool)
    (m : SignType) (w₀ w₁ : Option (Option Bool)) (d₀ d₁ : SignType) (emit : Option Bool)
    (hm : moveInputPos (⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (x.length + 2)) m = ⟨i' + 1, by omega⟩)
    (h₀ : (match w₀ with
      | none => satRedCounter n
      | some c => Function.update (satRedCounter n) a c) = satRedCounter n')
    (h₁ : (match w₁ with | none => buf | some c => Function.update buf b c) = buf')
    (ha : a + d₀.cast = a') (hb : b + d₁.cast = b')
    (ho : out ++ emit.toList = out') :
    (satRedAction m w₀ w₁ d₀ d₁ emit q').apply (satRedCfg x q i hi n buf a b out) =
      satRedCfg x q' i' hi' n' buf' a' b' out'

name: Complexity.satRed_move

    (buf : ℤ → Option Bool) (a b a' b' : ℤ) (out : List Bool)
    (m d₀ d₁ : SignType)
    (hm : moveInputPos (⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (x.length + 2)) m = ⟨i' + 1, by omega⟩)
    (ha : a + d₀.cast = a') (hb : b + d₁.cast = b')
    (ht : satRedTM.tm.tr q (x[i]?) (fun t : Fin 2 => if t = 0 then satRedCounter n a else buf b) =
      satRedAction m none none d₀ d₁ none (some q')) :
    satRedTM.tm.step (satRedCfg x (some q) i hi n buf a b out) =
      satRedCfg x (some q') i' hi' n buf a' b' out

name: Complexity.IterateFind.hostCtrl_eq
header:
theorem hostCtrl_eq (M : Fin 5 → FinTM Bool) (K : ℕ) (c : Fin 3) (inp : Option Bool)
    (work : Fin (K + 1) → Option Bool) :
    hostCtrl M K c inp work =
      if c = 0 then FinTM.controlAction 0 (some (ModuleHost.entry M 2))
      else if c = 1 then
        FinTM.controlAction 0
          (some (if work 0 = some true then ModuleHost.entry M 4 else ModuleHost.entry M 3))
      else FinTM.controlAction 0 none

name: Turing.universal_skip_record
header:
private lemma universal_skip_record {x : List Bool} {n : ℕ}
    (base : Cfg 4 Bool UniversalControl x) (dest : Option (Fin 9)) (rem : Fin 9)
    (table : List Bool) (state : ℤ → Option Bool) (sp : ℤ)
    (a : Action 1 Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (l r : List Bool)
    (ht : table = l ++ universalRecordBits a ++ r) :
    universalInterpreter.runFrom
      (universalEvalCfg base (.skipFixed dest rem 0) table l.length state sp)
      (universalRecordBits a).length =
    universalEvalCfg base
      (if h : rem.val = 0 then universalSkipDone dest
        else .skipFixed dest ⟨rem.val - 1, by omega⟩ 0)
      table (l.length + (universalRecordBits a).length) state sp

name: Complexity.sph_validation_run
header:
private lemma sph_validation_run {k : ℕ} {Q : Type}
    {ys : List (RecSym Q (Fin 3))} (d : Cfg k (RecSym Q (Fin 3)) (ScanPhase Bool) ys)
    (hd : d.state = some (.fwd true)) (hin : d.inputPos = 1) :
    ∃ b : Bool,
      (inputFoldTM k (fun a c => a && sphDigit c) true).runFrom d (2 * ys.length + 2) =
        {d with state := some (.done b)} ∧
      (b = true ↔ ∃ x : List Bool, ys = x.map (RecSym.digitEmb Q (Fin 3))) ∧
      (∀ u < 2 * ys.length + 2, ∀ a,
        ((inputFoldTM k (fun a c => a && sphDigit c) true).runFrom d u).state ≠
          some (.done a)) ∧
      ∀ j u, u ≤ 2 * ys.length + 2 →
        ((inputFoldTM k (fun a c => a && sphDigit c) true).runFrom d u).workTapePos j =
          d.workTapePos j

name: Turing.StepBlock.recordSkipTM_run
header:
lemma recordSkipTM_run {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x)
    (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (actionBitsK a).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((actionBitsK a)[r]'hr)) :
    (recordSkipTM k).runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk false)) ((actionBitsK a).length + 1) =
      { d.mapState (fun _ => (⟨true, SuccPhase.done a.state.isSome⟩ : Σ b, SkipPh k b)) with
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (tableTape k)
          (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + (actionBitsK a).length) }

name: Turing.StepBlock.recordSkipTM_spec
header:
lemma recordSkipTM_spec {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x)
    (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (actionBitsK a).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((actionBitsK a)[r]'hr)) :
    (∀ u < (actionBitsK a).length + 1, ∀ b,
      ((recordSkipTM k).runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk false)) u).state ≠ some ⟨true, .done b⟩) ∧
    (∀ u ≤ (actionBitsK a).length + 1,
      let f := (recordSkipTM k).runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk false)) u
      f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.output = d.output ∧
      (∀ j, f.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j +
        if j = tableTape k then ((min u (recordWidth k) + (u - (recordWidth k + 1)) : ℕ) : ℤ)
        else 0))

name: Turing.StepBlock.seekTM_request
header:
private lemma seekTM_request {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x)
    (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (rank rest : Fin (3 ^ (k + 1))) (last : Bool)
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (actionBitsK a).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((actionBitsK a)[r]'hr)) :
    (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.request rank rest last)) ((actionBitsK a).length + 3) =
      seekCfg ({ d with
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (tableTape k)
            (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + (actionBitsK a).length) }) (seekNext rank rest last) ∧
    (∀ u < (actionBitsK a).length + 3,
      ((seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.request rank rest last)) u).state ≠ some ⟨none, .done⟩) ∧
    (∀ u ≤ (actionBitsK a).length + 3,
      let f := (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.request rank rest last)) u
      f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.output = d.output ∧
      ∀ j, j ≠ tableTape k → f.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

name: Turing.StepBlock.seekTM_rank
header:
private lemma seekTM_rank {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (records : List (Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))))
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x) (rank : Fin (3 ^ (k + 1)))
    (hlen : records.length = rank.val)
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hs : d.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k) = some false)
    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (records.flatMap actionBitsK).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((records.flatMap actionBitsK)[r]'hr)) :
    (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.state rank)) (1 + seekCost records) =
      seekCfg ({d with
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (tableTape k)
          (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + (records.flatMap actionBitsK).length)}) .done ∧
    (∀ u < 1 + seekCost records,
      ((seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.state rank)) u).state ≠ some ⟨none, .done⟩) ∧
    (∀ u ≤ 1 + seekCost records,
      let f := (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.state rank)) u
      f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.output = d.output ∧
      ∀ j, j ≠ tableTape k → f.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

name: Turing.StepBlock.part
header:
private def part (k : ℕ) : (key : Key) → MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool (Ph k key)
  | .entry | .halt => ⟨(), fun _ _ _ => inputMoveAction 0 ()⟩
  | .lookup => seekTM k
  | .stateTail | .stateGap _ => skipTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k)
  | .stateHome | .stateRestore _ => skipBackTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k)
  | .clearState => clearTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k)
  | .toSummary | .finish _ => twoMoveTM (summaryTape k) .neg
  | .toState => twoMoveTM (summaryTape k) .pos
  | .record => recordTM k

private theorem recordStep_tape_run {k : ℕ} {Q T S : Type}
    [DecidableEq Q] [DecidableEq T] [DecidableEq S]
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) (upd : T → Option Bool → T)
    (seek : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool S) (start finish : S) {x : List Bool}
    (s : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (hc : c.InWindow s) (data : RecordStepData k Q T) (i : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg 4 (RecSym Q T) (RecordStepControl k Q T S) (x.map (RecSym.digitEmb Q T)))
    (hw : ∀ z : ℤ, -1 ≤ z → z ≤ (2 * s + 1 : ℕ) →
      d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + z) = FinTM.bufferTape
        ((List.range (2 * s + 1)).map fun (r : ℕ) =>
          RecSym.cell (c.workTapes i ((r : ℤ) - s)) (decide (c.workTapePos i = (r : ℤ) - s))) z) :
    RecordRun (recordStepMachine M upd seek start finish)
      (recordStepVerdict true) (recordStepVerdict false) d.workTapePos (2 * s + 2)
      {d with state := some ⟨⟨.writeTape i, data⟩, .fwd ()⟩}
      {d with
        state := some ⟨⟨.skipNewTape i, data⟩, .run⟩
        workTapes := fun j z =>
          if j = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ z ∧ z < d.workTapePos j + (2 * s + 1 : ℕ) then
            FinTM.bufferTape ((List.range (2 * s + 1)).map fun (r : ℕ) =>
              RecSym.cell (((recordStepAction M data).apply c).workTapes i ((r : ℤ) - s))
                (decide (((recordStepAction M data).apply c).workTapePos i = (r : ℤ) - s)))
              (z - d.workTapePos j)
          else d.workTapes j z} (4 * (2 * s + 1) + 6)

name: Turing.recordStep_apply_run
header:
private theorem recordStep_apply_run {k : ℕ} {Q T S : Type}
    [DecidableEq Q] [DecidableEq T] [DecidableEq S]
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) (upd : T → Option Bool → T)
    (seek : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool S) (start finish : S) {x : List Bool}
    (s : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (τ : T) (hc : c.InWindow s)
    (data : RecordStepData k Q T) (hinput : data.input = c.inputSymbol)
    (hzero : data.posZero = decide (c.inputPos.val = 0)) (htag : data.tag = some τ)
    (d : Cfg 4 (RecSym Q T) (RecordStepControl k Q T S) (x.map (RecSym.digitEmb Q T)))
    (hrec : RecordAt d 0 (cfgRecord s c τ))
    (blank : ∀ j : Fin 4, j ≠ 0 → ∀ z, d.workTapes j z = none) :
    ∃ t ≤ 40 * (k + 3) * ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length + 1),
      RecordRun (recordStepMachine M upd seek start finish)
        (recordStepVerdict true) (recordStepVerdict false) d.workTapePos
        ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length + 1)
        (recordStepSnapshot d (⟨⟨.writeState, data⟩, .fwd ()⟩ : RecordStepControl k Q T S) 0
          ((binDigits (posWidth x.length) c.inputPos.val).map (RecSym.digitEmb Q T)) [])
        {d with
          state := some (recordStepVerdict true)
          workTapes := fun j z =>
            if j = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ z ∧ z < d.workTapePos j + ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length : ℤ)
              then fieldsTape (cfgRecord s ((recordStepAction M data).apply c)
                (upd τ (recordStepAction M data).output)) (z - d.workTapePos j)
              else d.workTapes j z} t

    [DecidableEq Q] [DecidableEq T] [DecidableEq S]
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) (upd : T → Option Bool → T)
    (seek : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool S) (start finish : S) {x : List Bool}
    (s : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (hc : c.InWindow s) (data : RecordStepData k Q T) (i : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg 4 (RecSym Q T) (RecordStepControl k Q T S) (x.map (RecSym.digitEmb Q T)))
    (hw : ∀ z : ℤ, -1 ≤ z → z ≤ (2 * s + 1 : ℕ) →
      d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + z) = FinTM.bufferTape
        ((List.range (2 * s + 1)).map fun (r : ℕ) =>
          RecSym.cell (c.workTapes i ((r : ℤ) - s)) (decide (c.workTapePos i = (r : ℤ) - s))) z) :
    RecordSeg (recordStepMachine M upd seek start finish)
      (recordStepVerdict true) (recordStepVerdict false) d.workTapePos (2 * s + 2)
      {d with state := some ⟨⟨.writeTape i, data⟩, .fwd ()⟩}
      {d with
        state := some ⟨⟨.skipNewTape i, data⟩, .run⟩
        workTapes := fun j z =>
          if j = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ z ∧ z < d.workTapePos j + (2 * s + 1 : ℕ) then
            FinTM.bufferTape ((List.range (2 * s + 1)).map fun (r : ℕ) =>
              RecSym.cell (((recordStepAction M data).apply c).workTapes i ((r : ℤ) - s))
                (decide (((recordStepAction M data).apply c).workTapePos i = (r : ℤ) - s)))
              (z - d.workTapePos j)
          else d.workTapes j z} (4 * (2 * s + 1) + 6)

    (seek : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool S) (start finish : S) {x : List Bool}
    (s : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (τ : T) (hc : c.InWindow s)
    (data : RecordStepData k Q T) (hinput : data.input = c.inputSymbol)
    (hzero : data.posZero = decide (c.inputPos.val = 0)) (htag : data.tag = some τ)
    (d : Cfg 4 (RecSym Q T) (RecordStepControl k Q T S) (x.map (RecSym.digitEmb Q T)))
    (hrec : RecordAt d 0 (cfgRecord s c τ))
    (blank : ∀ j : Fin 4, j ≠ 0 → ∀ z, d.workTapes j z = none) :
    ∃ t ≤ 40 * (k + 3) * ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length + 1),
      RecordSeg (recordStepMachine M upd seek start finish)
        (recordStepVerdict true) (recordStepVerdict false) d.workTapePos
        ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length + 1)
        (recordStepSnapshot d (⟨⟨.writeState, data⟩, .fwd ()⟩ : RecordStepControl k Q T S) 0
          ((binDigits (posWidth x.length) c.inputPos.val).map (RecSym.digitEmb Q T)) [])
        {d with
          state := some (recordStepVerdict true)
          workTapes := fun j z =>
            if j = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ z ∧ z < d.workTapePos j + ((joinFields (cfgRecord s c τ)).length : ℤ)
              then fieldsTape (cfgRecord s ((recordStepAction M data).apply c)
                (upd τ (recordStepAction M data).output)) (z - d.workTapePos j)
              else d.workTapes j z} t

    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (actionBitsK a).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((actionBitsK a)[r]'hr)) :
    (recordSkipTM k).runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk false)) ((actionBitsK a).length + 1) =
      { d.mapState (fun _ => (⟨true, SuccPhase.done a.state.isSome⟩ : Σ b, SkipPh k b)) with
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (tableTape k)

name: Turing.StepBlock.recordSkipTM_spec
header:

    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x)
    (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (actionBitsK a).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((actionBitsK a)[r]'hr)) :
    (∀ u < (actionBitsK a).length + 1, ∀ b,
      ((recordSkipTM k).runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk false)) u).state ≠ some ⟨true, .done b⟩) ∧
    (∀ u ≤ (actionBitsK a).length + 1,
      let f := (recordSkipTM k).runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk false)) u
      f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.output = d.output ∧
      (∀ j, f.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j +
        if j = tableTape k then ((min u (recordWidth k) + (u - (recordWidth k + 1)) : ℕ) : ℤ)
        else 0))

      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((actionBitsK a)[r]'hr)) :

      seekCfg ({ d with
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (tableTape k)
            (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + (actionBitsK a).length) }) (seekNext rank rest last) ∧
    (∀ u < (actionBitsK a).length + 3,
      ((seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.request rank rest last)) u).state ≠ some ⟨none, .done⟩) ∧
    (∀ u ≤ (actionBitsK a).length + 3,
      let f := (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.request rank rest last)) u
      f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.output = d.output ∧
      ∀ j, j ≠ tableTape k → f.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

name: Turing.StepBlock.seekTM_rank

    (records : List (Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))))
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x) (rank : Fin (3 ^ (k + 1)))
    (hlen : records.length = rank.val)
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hs : d.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k) = some false)
    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (records.flatMap actionBitsK).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((records.flatMap actionBitsK)[r]'hr)) :
    (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.state rank)) (1 + seekCost records) =
      seekCfg ({d with
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (tableTape k)
          (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + (records.flatMap actionBitsK).length)}) .done ∧
    (∀ u < 1 + seekCost records,
      ((seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.state rank)) u).state ≠ some ⟨none, .done⟩) ∧
    (∀ u ≤ 1 + seekCost records,
      let f := (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.state rank)) u
      f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.output = d.output ∧
      ∀ j, j ≠ tableTape k → f.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

name: Turing.StepBlock.part
header:
private def part (k : ℕ) : (key : Key) → MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool (Ph k key)
  | .entry | .halt => ⟨(), fun _ _ _ => inputMoveAction 0 ()⟩
  | .lookup => seekTM k
  | .stateTail | .stateGap _ => skipTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k)
  | .stateHome | .stateRestore _ => skipBackTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k)
  | .clearState => clearTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k)
  | .toSummary | .finish _ => twoMoveTM (summaryTape k) .neg
  | .toState => twoMoveTM (summaryTape k) .pos
  | .record => recordTM k
  | .successor => succFieldTM (tableTape k) (summaryTape k) true
  | .tableTail _ => skipTM (k + 2) (tableTape k)
  | .tableHome _ => skipBackTM (k + 2) (tableTape k)

private lemma enumCont_first_anchor {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm stop : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (qa : S)
    (ha : ∀ q, q ≠ qa → ∀ inp work, tm.tr q inp work = stop.tr q inp work)
    (hs : ∀ inp work, stop.tr qa inp work = controlAction 0 (some qa))
    (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (T : ℕ) (hT : (stop.runFrom c T).state = some qa) :
    ∃ t ≤ T, (∀ j < t, (tm.runFrom c j).state ≠ some qa) ∧
      tm.runFrom c t = stop.runFrom c T

      tm.runFrom c r = {c with state := dest, inputPos := 1}

name: exists_inputLengthTM
header:
theorem exists_inputLengthTM :
    ∃ (K : ℕ) (S : Type) (_ : Fintype S) (_ : DecidableEq S) (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 1) Bool S)
      (entry exit : S) (C : ℕ),
      ∀ {x : List Bool} (d : Cfg (K + 1) Bool S x), d.state = some entry → d.inputPos = 1 →
        (∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ((Nat.bits x.length).length : ℤ) →
          d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + p) = none) →
        (∀ j : Fin (K + 1), j ≠ 0 → ∀ p, d.workTapes j p = none) →
        ∃ t ≤ C * (x.length + 1),
          (∀ u < t, (R.runFrom d u).state ≠ some exit) ∧
          (∀ u ≤ t, ∀ j : Fin (K + 1),
            |(R.runFrom d u).workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤
              ((C * ((Nat.bits x.length).length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∧
          R.runFrom d t =
            { d with
              state := some exit
              workTapes := fun j q =>
                if j = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧
                    q < d.workTapePos j + ((Nat.bits x.length).length : ℤ)
                  then FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits x.length) (q - d.workTapePos j)
                else d.workTapes j q }

    (q : M.State) (x s y : List Bool) (T : ℕ)

name: rewind_first_step

    (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (hs : c.state = some start) :

name: rewind_from_any

      match inp with
      | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan)
      | none => controlAction .pos dest)

name: rewind_heads
header:
theorem rewind_heads {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (start scan : S) (dest : Option S)
    (hstart : ∀ inp work, tm.tr start inp work = controlAction .neg (some scan))
    (hscan : ∀ inp work, tm.tr scan inp work = match inp with
      | some _ => controlAction .neg (some scan)
      | none => controlAction .pos dest)
    (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (hs : c.state = some start) :
    ∃ r ≤ c.inputPos.val + 2,
      tm.runFrom c r = {c with state := dest, inputPos := 1} ∧
      ∀ u ≤ r, (tm.runFrom c u).workTapePos = c.workTapePos

    (hw : ∀ i : Fin (recordWidth k),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + i.val) = some (bits i))
    (hbits : List.ofFn bits = (actionBitsK a).take (recordWidth k)) :
    (recordTM k).runFrom d (recordWidth k + 1) =
      (applyPayload (⟨a.inputTape, a.workTapes, a.output, none⟩ : Action k Bool (Fin 1))
        (d.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k))).apply

name: Turing.StepBlock.recordSkipTM_run
header:
lemma recordSkipTM_run {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x)
    (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (actionBitsK a).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((actionBitsK a)[r]'hr)) :
    (recordSkipTM k).runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk false)) ((actionBitsK a).length + 1) =
      { d.mapState (fun _ => (⟨true, SuccPhase.done a.state.isSome⟩ : Σ b, SkipPh k b)) with
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (tableTape k)
          (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + (actionBitsK a).length) }

name: Turing.StepBlock.recordSkipTM_spec
header:
lemma recordSkipTM_spec {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x)
    (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (actionBitsK a).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((actionBitsK a)[r]'hr)) :
    (∀ u < (actionBitsK a).length + 1, ∀ b,
      ((recordSkipTM k).runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk false)) u).state ≠ some ⟨true, .done b⟩) ∧
    (∀ u ≤ (actionBitsK a).length + 1,
      let f := (recordSkipTM k).runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk false)) u
      f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.output = d.output ∧
      (∀ j, f.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j +
        if j = tableTape k then ((min u (recordWidth k) + (u - (recordWidth k + 1)) : ℕ) : ℤ)
        else 0))

name: Turing.StepBlock.seekTM_request
header:
private lemma seekTM_request {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x)
    (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (rank rest : Fin (3 ^ (k + 1))) (last : Bool)
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (actionBitsK a).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((actionBitsK a)[r]'hr)) :
    (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.request rank rest last)) ((actionBitsK a).length + 3) =
      seekCfg ({ d with
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (tableTape k)
            (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + (actionBitsK a).length) }) (seekNext rank rest last) ∧
    (∀ u < (actionBitsK a).length + 3,
      ((seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.request rank rest last)) u).state ≠ some ⟨none, .done⟩) ∧
    (∀ u ≤ (actionBitsK a).length + 3,
      let f := (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.request rank rest last)) u
      f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.output = d.output ∧
      ∀ j, j ≠ tableTape k → f.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

name: Turing.StepBlock.seekTM_rank
header:
private lemma seekTM_rank {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (records : List (Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))))
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x) (rank : Fin (3 ^ (k + 1)))
    (hlen : records.length = rank.val)
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hs : d.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k) = some false)
    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (records.flatMap actionBitsK).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((records.flatMap actionBitsK)[r]'hr)) :
    (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.state rank)) (1 + seekCost records) =
      seekCfg ({d with
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (tableTape k)
          (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + (records.flatMap actionBitsK).length)}) .done ∧
    (∀ u < 1 + seekCost records,
      ((seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.state rank)) u).state ≠ some ⟨none, .done⟩) ∧
    (∀ u ≤ 1 + seekCost records,
      let f := (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.state rank)) u
      f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.output = d.output ∧
      ∀ j, j ≠ tableTape k → f.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

name: Turing.StepBlock.part
header:
private def part (k : ℕ) : (key : Key) → MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool (Ph k key)
  | .entry | .halt => ⟨(), fun _ _ _ => inputMoveAction 0 ()⟩
  | .lookup => seekTM k
  | .stateTail | .stateGap _ => skipTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k)
  | .stateHome | .stateRestore _ => skipBackTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k)
  | .clearState => clearTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k)
  | .toSummary | .finish _ => twoMoveTM (summaryTape k) .neg
  | .toState => twoMoveTM (summaryTape k) .pos
  | .record => recordTM k
  | .successor => succFieldTM (tableTape k) (summaryTape k) true
  | .tableTail _ => skipTM (k + 2) (tableTape k)
  | .tableHome _ => skipBackTM (k + 2) (tableTape k)

    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x)

    (tr : Fin (n + 1) → Option Bool → (Fin k → Option Bool) → Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (q : Fin (n + 1)) (hq : c.state = some q)
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x)
    (entry : d.state = some ⟨.entry, ()⟩) (rel : Rep tr c d) :

      ∀ u, 0 < u → u < T →

      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((actionBitsK a)[r]'hr)) :
    (recordSkipTM k).runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk false)) ((actionBitsK a).length + 1) =
      { d.mapState (fun _ => (⟨true, SuccPhase.done a.state.isSome⟩ : Σ b, SkipPh k b)) with
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (tableTape k)

name: Turing.StepBlock.recordSkipTM_spec
header:
lemma recordSkipTM_spec {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x)
    (a : Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (actionBitsK a).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((actionBitsK a)[r]'hr)) :
    (∀ u < (actionBitsK a).length + 1, ∀ b,
      ((recordSkipTM k).runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk false)) u).state ≠ some ⟨true, .done b⟩) ∧
    (∀ u ≤ (actionBitsK a).length + 1,
      let f := (recordSkipTM k).runFrom (d.mapState (Sigma.mk false)) u
      f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.output = d.output ∧
      (∀ j, f.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j +
        if j = tableTape k then ((min u (recordWidth k) + (u - (recordWidth k + 1)) : ℕ) : ℤ)
        else 0))

    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (actionBitsK a).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((actionBitsK a)[r]'hr)) :
    (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.request rank rest last)) ((actionBitsK a).length + 3) =
      seekCfg ({ d with
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (tableTape k)
            (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + (actionBitsK a).length) }) (seekNext rank rest last) ∧
    (∀ u < (actionBitsK a).length + 3,
      ((seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.request rank rest last)) u).state ≠ some ⟨none, .done⟩) ∧
    (∀ u ≤ (actionBitsK a).length + 3,
      let f := (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.request rank rest last)) u
      f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.output = d.output ∧
      ∀ j, j ≠ tableTape k → f.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

name: Turing.StepBlock.seekTM_rank
header:
private lemma seekTM_rank {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (records : List (Action k Bool (Fin (n + 1))))
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (RecordState k) x) (rank : Fin (3 ^ (k + 1)))
    (hlen : records.length = rank.val)
    (hq : d.state = some (recordTM k).q₀)
    (hs : d.workTapeSymbols (summaryTape k) = some false)
    (hw : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r < (records.flatMap actionBitsK).length),
      d.workTapes (tableTape k) (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + r) =
        some ((records.flatMap actionBitsK)[r]'hr)) :
    (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.state rank)) (1 + seekCost records) =
      seekCfg ({d with
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos (tableTape k)
          (d.workTapePos (tableTape k) + (records.flatMap actionBitsK).length)}) .done ∧
    (∀ u < 1 + seekCost records,
      ((seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.state rank)) u).state ≠ some ⟨none, .done⟩) ∧
    (∀ u ≤ 1 + seekCost records,
      let f := (seekTM k).runFrom (seekCfg d (.state rank)) u
      f.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ f.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ f.output = d.output ∧
      ∀ j, j ≠ tableTape k → f.workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j)

name: Turing.StepBlock.part
header:
private def part (k : ℕ) : (key : Key) → MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool (Ph k key)
  | .entry | .halt => ⟨(), fun _ _ _ => inputMoveAction 0 ()⟩
  | .lookup => seekTM k
  | .stateTail | .stateGap _ => skipTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k)
  | .stateHome | .stateRestore _ => skipBackTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k)
  | .clearState => clearTM (k + 2) (summaryTape k)
  | .toSummary | .finish _ => twoMoveTM (summaryTape k) .neg
  | .toState => twoMoveTM (summaryTape k) .pos
  | .record => recordTM k
  | .successor => succFieldTM (tableTape k) (summaryTape k) true
  | .tableTail _ => skipTM (k + 2) (tableTape k)
  | .tableHome _ => skipBackTM (k + 2) (tableTape k)

header:
def tr (exact : Bool) : St → Option Bool → (Fin 2 → Option Bool) → Action 2 Bool St
  | .rd1 φ, some b, _ => LA.toAct .pos (.go (.rd2 φ b))
  | .rd1 _, none, _ => LA.toAct 0 .rej
  | .rd2 φ b, some b', w => match pairSym b b' with
    | some s => LA.toAct .pos (lact φ s (w 0) (w 1))
    | none => LA.toAct 0 .rej
  | .rd2 _ _, none, _ => LA.toAct 0 .rej
  | .rewM, _, w =>
    if (w 1).isSome then LA.toAct 0 ⟨none, none, .neg, none, some .rewM⟩
    else LA.toAct 0 ⟨none, none, .pos, none, some .copy⟩
  | .copy, inp, w =>
    if (w 1).isSome then
      match inp with
      | some b => LA.toAct .pos ⟨some (some b), some none, .pos, none, some .copy⟩
      | none => LA.toAct 0 .rej
    else if exact && inp.isSome then LA.toAct 0 .rej
    else LA.toAct 0 ⟨none, none, .neg, none, some (.rewV none)⟩
  | .rewV d, _, w =>
    if (w 0).isSome then LA.toAct 0 ⟨none, none, .neg, none, some (.rewV d)⟩
    else LA.toAct 0 ⟨none, none, .pos, none, some (match d with
      | none => .rewI0
      | some φ => .rd1 φ)⟩
  | .rewI0, _, _ => FinTM.controlAction .neg (some .rewI)
  | .rewI, inp, _ => match inp with
    | some _ => FinTM.controlAction .neg (some .rewI)
    | none => FinTM.controlAction .pos (some (.rd1 .skipN))
  | .app v, _, w =>
    if (w 0).isSome then LA.toAct 0 ⟨none, some none, .pos, none, some (.app v)⟩
    else LA.toAct 0 ⟨some (some v), some none, .neg, none, some (.rewV (some .g))⟩

    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) (upd : T → Option Bool → T)
    (seek : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool S) (start finish : S) {x : List Bool}
    (s : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (hc : c.InWindow s) (data : RecordStepData k Q T) (i : Fin k)
    (d : Cfg 4 (RecSym Q T) (RecordStepControl k Q T S) (x.map (RecSym.digitEmb Q T)))
    (hw : ∀ z : ℤ, -1 ≤ z → z ≤ (2 * s + 1 : ℕ) →
      d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + z) = FinTM.bufferTape
        ((List.range (2 * s + 1)).map fun (r : ℕ) =>
          RecSym.cell (c.workTapes i ((r : ℤ) - s)) (decide (c.workTapePos i = (r : ℤ) - s))) z) :
    RecordSeg (recordStepMachine M upd seek start finish)
      (recordStepVerdict true) (recordStepVerdict false) d.workTapePos (2 * s + 2)
      {d with state := some ⟨⟨.writeTape i, data⟩, .fwd ()⟩}
      {d with
        state := some ⟨⟨.skipNewTape i, data⟩, .run⟩
        workTapes := fun j z =>
          if j = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ z ∧ z < d.workTapePos j + (2 * s + 1 : ℕ) then
            FinTM.bufferTape ((List.range (2 * s + 1)).map fun (r : ℕ) =>
              RecSym.cell (((recordStepAction M data).apply c).workTapes i ((r : ℤ) - s))
                (decide (((recordStepAction M data).apply c).workTapePos i = (r : ℤ) - s)))
              (z - d.workTapePos j)
          else d.workTapes j z} (4 * (2 * s + 1) + 6)

    (blank : ∀ j : Fin 4, j ≠ 0 → ∀ z, d.workTapes j z = none) :
